description: Invitation dispatch worker: pick the next staged event and send.

preconditions: Email delivery is disabled.
cases.return: 0; nothing is read.

preconditions: No dispatch with this id.
A dispatch already Materialized.
cases.return: 0; unchanged.

preconditions: A dispatch already Suppressed.
cases.return: 0; unchanged.

preconditions: A Pending dispatch whose NextAttemptAt is 03:10Z; the clock is 03:00Z.
cases.return: 0; unchanged, it is not due.

preconditions: A Pending dispatch whose NextAttemptAt equals the clock, 03:00Z.
cases.return: 1 (an email is queued): a dispatch due exactly now is processed.

preconditions: Another worker holds the lock on the dispatch.
cases.return: 0; the transaction ends without committing.

preconditions: The dispatch was settled by another worker between the first read and the lock.
cases.return: 0; no commit.

preconditions: An email with the same deduplication key already exists.
cases.return: 0 emails queued.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes Materialized and points at the existing email id; no new email is added.

preconditions: An Invitation dispatch for a participant who is no longer active on the roster.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes Suppressed; no email.

preconditions: An Invitation dispatch for a meeting that is now Cancelled.
A Rescheduled dispatch for a meeting that is now Ended.
A Cancelled dispatch for a person who is no longer on the roster.
A Cancelled dispatch for a current participant; the meeting is Cancelled.
cases.return: 1: the cancellation notice still goes to everyone on the roster.

preconditions: A Removed dispatch for a person already off the roster; the meeting is Ended; the invitation email was sent.
cases.return: 1: a withdrawal is not moot because the person left.

preconditions: A Removed dispatch; the invitation was never turned into an email and no email with the initial key exists.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes Suppressed: a withdrawal is only worth sending if the invitation went out.

preconditions: A Removed dispatch; the invitation dispatch is Materialized.
A Removed dispatch; no materialized invitation dispatch, but an email with the participant's initial delivery key exists (sent before dispatch rows existed).
A Cancelled dispatch for a Guest; the Guest's invitation was never emailed.
An Invitation dispatch for an internal participant on a Published meeting.
Participant Bình, role Member; application base URL https://tc.example.vn/.
cases.return: 1 email queued: subject "Lời mời tham dự cuộc họp: <title>"; text body with greeting, start, end, "Vai trò: Thành viên", place and "Xem cuộc họp: https://tc.example.vn/mgmt/meetings/<meetingId>"; the organizer's name and email as contact; an HTML body from the invitation template; a METHOD:REQUEST calendar attachment.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes Materialized, EmailMessageId set, LastError empty, NextAttemptAt cleared.

preconditions: A Rescheduled dispatch whose payload holds the previous start 09:00.
cases.return: 1 email: the body has a "Thời gian cũ" line before the new start; no calendar attachment.

preconditions: A Rescheduled dispatch staged before the previous time was recorded (PreviousStartsAt null).
cases.return: 1 email: no "Thời gian cũ" line.

preconditions: A RoleChanged dispatch for Bình, new role Secretary.
cases.return: 1 email with "Vai trò: Thư ký"; no calendar attachment.

preconditions: A Cancelled dispatch for an internal participant, reason "Hoãn do lịch bận".
cases.return: 1 email: subject "Cuộc họp đã bị huỷ: <title>"; body has the planned time and "Lý do huỷ: Hoãn do lịch bận" and no meeting link; the HTML has no button; the calendar attachment is METHOD:CANCEL.

preconditions: A Removed dispatch for Bình (invitation was sent).
cases.return: 1 email: subject "Lời mời tham dự đã được thu hồi: <title>"; body has no times and no link; no calendar attachment.

preconditions: An Invitation dispatch for a Guest; the link provider is available and prepares the verification link https://tc.example.vn/guest/verify?t=abc.
cases.return: 1 email: body without a place, with "Xác minh email để truy cập cuộc họp: https://tc.example.vn/guest/verify?t=abc"; the contact is the organizer's name only, with no staff email; calendar attachment with an empty description and location.

preconditions: A meeting title containing a line break and 320 characters.
cases.return: 1 email: subject has the line break replaced by a space and is cut to 300 characters.

preconditions: The subject's 300th character would split an emoji (a surrogate pair at positions 299 and 300).
cases.return: 1 email: the subject is cut to 299 characters so the pair is not split.

preconditions: A Guest dispatch (not a withdrawal); the link provider reports itself unavailable; the Guest invitation is active; the meeting is open; DependencyAttemptCount 0.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes BlockedDependency with NextAttemptAt now + 1 minute; no lock on the meeting is taken.

preconditions: Same, DependencyAttemptCount 1, 2, 3.
cases.inputs: id of the dispatch, three times.
cases.return: 0 each time.
cases.log: NextAttemptAt is now + 5 minutes, + 30 minutes and + 360 minutes; 360 minutes also for any higher count.

preconditions: A Guest dispatch; link provider unavailable; the Guest invitation was revoked.
cases.log: The dispatch is Suppressed instead of waiting.

preconditions: A Guest dispatch; link provider unavailable; the meeting is closed (Ended or Cancelled).
A Guest Removed dispatch; link provider unavailable.
cases.return: 1: a withdrawal needs no link, so the availability probe is skipped.

preconditions: The link provider is available but its preparation returns Unavailable.
cases.inputs: id of a Guest Invitation dispatch.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes BlockedDependency, NextAttemptAt now + 1 minute, DependencyAttemptCount incremented, LastError "Unavailable".

preconditions: The link provider returns Invalid for the Guest invitation.
cases.inputs: id of a Guest Invitation dispatch.
cases.log: The dispatch becomes Suppressed with LastError "Invalid".

preconditions: The link provider returns a URL on another origin, https://evil.example/verify.
cases.inputs: id of a Guest Invitation dispatch; configured base https://tc.example.vn.
cases.return: 0: the dispatch is not turned into an email.
cases.exception: A JsonException is raised inside, caught by the processor and recorded as a failed attempt.
cases.log: RecordFailedAttempt with the failure type "JsonException"; a warning is logged with the type only, never the URL.

preconditions: The link provider returns a non-web URL, ftp://tc.example.vn/verify.
cases.inputs: id of a Guest Invitation dispatch.

preconditions: The dispatch's payload version is 2.
cases.exception: Unsupported invitation payload version, handled as a failed attempt.
cases.log: RecordFailedAttempt(MaxAttempts 8, failure type JsonException); the transaction is discarded and nothing is queued.

preconditions: The dispatch's payload is the JSON text null.
cases.exception: Missing invitation payload, handled as a failed attempt.

preconditions: A dispatch that failed twice before (AttemptCount 2); the next failure occurs at 03:00Z.
A dispatch with AttemptCount 4; failure at 03:00Z.
cases.log: RetryAt is 03:15:00Z: 60 s x 16 = 960 s is capped at 900 s.

preconditions: The host cancels the work while a dispatch is being processed.
cases.return: No result.
cases.exception: The cancellation is not swallowed; no failed attempt is recorded.
